F_SK_Crew.name: Slip Knife crew / Verge runner auxiliary
F_SK_Crew.text: Independent-minded blockade-runner crew operating in the Verge Campaign era. They work beside larger institutions without behaving like a polished naval bridge crew. Their authority comes from competence, market oaths and the practical knowledge required to move cargo through contested space.

F_Luminara.name: Luminara agricultural cooperatives
F_Luminara.text: Farmers, greenhouse crews and cargo workers moving grain and seed stock toward hungry Verge settlements. Their stakes are civilian and logistical; the cargo is food first, politics second.

F_Auric_Blockade.name: Auric Gate splinter blockade
F_Auric_Blockade.text: A local Shard-aligned warlord force using the Gate chokepoint to seize cargo and control passage during the Verge Campaigns. Their hulls use dark salvage metal with red identifiers. They do not represent all Shard communities or later Shard political positions.
